newsitem.title: USA: Greyhound says May ticket sales up 8.1 pct.
newsitem.headline: Greyhound says May ticket sales up 8.1 pct.

text.p: Greyhound Lines Inc said Thursday that passenger ticket sales rose 8.1 percent in May over the same month last year at its 198 largest electronic reporting locations.
The number of passengers traveling on Greyhound rose 8.5 percent in May, while passenger miles increased by 10.6 percent, the company said.
The sales gains reflect improvements in Greyhound's core transportation business and greater use of advance-purchase discount fares, the company said.
Yield, or sales per passenger mile, declined 2.3 percent for May, reflecting promotional pricing and an increase in average trip length, it said.
